headword: {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}

definitions.explanation: A product or offer available only in limited numbers, often used to create urgency or exclusivity.

examples.japanese: {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It will be sold in limited quantities.

examples.japanese: {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}100⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧お⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れる→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: Limited quantity items sell out quickly.

notes:
{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい} is a common marketing term in Japan, often seen on signs and advertisements to indicate scarcity and encourage quick purchases.

- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (limited quantity product)
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (limited quantity sale)
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}○⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ (limited to X units)
